description: Poll a screen region and return as soon as enough pixels have changed vs. the baseline (or timeout). Useful for waiting on visual events: a spinner finishing, a notification appearing, content loading. Uses RGB diff with a per-channel threshold of 8.

poll_interval_ms.description: Delay between screenshots in ms (default 500, min 100).

region.description: Region to watch {x, y, w, h} in screen pixels.

threshold.description: Percentage of pixels (0-100) that must differ for the region to count as changed (default 5).

timeout_ms.description: Max time to wait in ms (default 60000, max 600000).

name: jrd_watch_region
